derived.prompt: Europa directly orbits Jupiter. Does it follow that Europa does not directly orbit Saturn?
chain: Europa directly orbits Jupiter. (given in prompt)
'Orbits directly' is not functional: a body can directly orbit more than one body. (edit)
So orbiting Jupiter no longer rules out orbiting Saturn: no.

derived.prompt: Triton directly orbits Neptune. Does it follow that Triton does not directly orbit Uranus?
chain: Triton directly orbits Neptune. (given in prompt)
'Orbits directly' is not functional: a body can directly orbit more than one body. (edit)
So orbiting Neptune no longer rules out orbiting Uranus: no.

notes: RBox edit: functionality removed from a relation that has it (a moon directly orbits one body). The premises are real, and the conclusions (Europa does not orbit Saturn, Triton does not orbit Uranus) are true in the world and follow before the edit (yes); after it they no longer follow (no). 'Directly' keeps the Sun out (a moon also goes round the Sun with its planet). The Chinese prompt names Europa 欧罗巴 rather than 木卫二 ('Jupiter II').
